environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting, no WAF attached. Service is directly accessible from the internet via the ALB DNS name. ECS task role has no restrictions on network egress.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, forwards HTTP to container port 3000
